text:
Sara (Recruiting Ops): Heads up — noticed LMS completion isn't flipping `interviewer_certified` in ATS for external hires. Candidates marked completed in LMS but ATS shows false.
Mike (People Ops): Hmm — how long since rollout?
Sara (Recruiting Ops): Since the onboarding LMS update yesterday. Only affects external contractor role template.
Jin (DevEx): Can you paste the webhook payload when it happens?
Sara (Recruiting Ops): Sure: ```
POST /webhooks/lms-event
{
  "candidate_id": "C-12345",
  "event": "course.completed",
  "meta": { "course_id": "intv-cert-v2", "status": "passed" }
}
```
Jin (DevEx): I see: our sync looks for `meta.certified: true` not `meta.status: "passed"` — mismatch.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): We rolled the LMS change that normalized `status` yesterday 03:14 UTC (deploy #2023). Looks like we didn't update the mapper.
ATS Sync Bot: ERROR 2024-04-05T03:19:41Z - mapper: missing field 'certified' in payload for candidate C-12345
Mike (People Ops): Ok — short term: can we map `status: "passed"` => `interviewer_certified=true` in the sync service?
Jin (DevEx): Yes, small change. I'll open PR and tag @ravi for infra review. ETA 2 hrs.
Sara (Recruiting Ops): Great — can we also backfill candidates in the last 48h? We have a training cohort starting Monday.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): I'll queue a backfill job once PR is merged. Need to confirm idempotency; will run in dry-run first.
Mike (People Ops): I'll prepare a quick checklist for recruiting to manual-verify any flagged candidates.
Sara (Recruiting Ops): Also: add a unit test for webhook schema mapping please.
Jin (DevEx): Will do. PR: https://git.internal/r/devex/mapper/pulls/42 :thumbsup: 
Sara (Recruiting Ops): Thanks all. Please ping here when deployed so I can kick off the backfill.
Jin (DevEx): Deployed 2024-04-05T05:12Z. Mapper now accepts status:passed and maps to interviewer_certified.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Backfill started 2024-04-05T05:20Z — dry-run showed 18 candidates, 12 would flip to true.
Sara (Recruiting Ops): Confirmed — we manually verified 2 contractors; rest auto-updated. All good. :white_check_mark:
Mike (People Ops): Leaving a note in hiring-ops-runbook and adding a postmortem checklist. Closing here unless anything else.
Sara (Recruiting Ops): All good from me — thanks! :raised_hands:
